description.en: Biography of Yixin Cui, a composer and scholar based in Rochester, New York.
description.zh: 作曲家崔浥新的個人簡介。

intro.en: is a composer and scholar from Hokkien, based in Rochester, New York. They study composition and piano technology at the [Eastman School of Music](https://www.esm.rochester.edu).
intro.zh: 是一位來自福建、現居紐約州羅切斯特的作曲家與學者，於[伊斯曼音樂學院](https://www.esm.rochester.edu)研習作曲與鋼琴維修技術。

body.en:
Their compositions span solo, chamber, choral, and orchestral music. Works include [*Bayanbulak*](/works/bayanbulak/) for solo viola (2023), [*Twink Death*](/works/twink-death/) for two actors and large ensemble (2025), and [*Impasse of the Weasels*](/works/impasse-of-the-weasels/) for orchestra (2025).

Alongside composition, they perform as a pianist and conductor. They [conducted the Swarthmore College Garnet Singers](/events/swarthmore-chorus-garnet-singers/) in 2025 and [performed as pianist in the première of *Sonatinetta II*](/events/duncan-wall-senior-recital/) with horn player Duncan Wall in 2026.
body.zh:
創作涵蓋獨奏、室內樂、合唱與管弦樂，作品包括中提琴獨奏曲[《Bayanbulak 巴音布魯克》](/works/bayanbulak/)（2023）、為兩名演員與大型合奏而作的[《Twink Death 菊花殘》](/works/twink-death/)（2025），以及管弦樂作品[《Impasse of the Weasels 鼬ノ困》](/works/impasse-of-the-weasels/)（2025）。

除作曲之外，也從事鋼琴演奏與指揮。2025 年曾[指揮 Swarthmore College Garnet Singers](/events/swarthmore-chorus-garnet-singers/)；2026 年與法國號演奏者 Duncan Wall 合作，於[《Sonatinetta II 微奏鳴曲 II》首演中擔任鋼琴演奏](/events/duncan-wall-senior-recital/)。
